root_cause.text: The bpf_xdp_store_bytes helper's third argument was incorrectly declared as `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM` (which implies writable memory) instead of a read-only memory type, causing the verifier to reject valid read-only map pointers and potentially allowing the helper to read from uninitialized memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `arg3_type` from `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM` to `ARG_PTR_TO_MEM | MEM_RDONLY`. The CVE description shows that the verifier threw "write into map forbidden" when using a read-only map (BPF_F_RDONLY_PROG) because the MEM_WRITE flag was incorrectly set, and notes that `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM` can also lead to reading uninitialized memory.
